candidate.base: Strict-prior player PA-outcome posterior shrunk to the fold-trained league distribution, exposed as explicit model inputs.
candidate.model: Regularized multinomial logistic model. The EB probabilities are features, not a claimed offset or residual; no manually specified baseball direction or multiplier is used.
candidate.solver: newton-cholesky multiclass logistic regression; fixed finite convergence criterion.

inner_selection.algorithm: nested expanding TimeSeriesSplit over sorted unique 2023 game dates
inner_selection.tie_breaker: lowest mean validation log loss, then lower regularization_c, then greater prior_strength_pa

outer_evaluation.algorithm: expanding TimeSeriesSplit over sorted unique 2023 game dates

evidence_boundary.feature_cutoff: max_source_date is null or strictly before game_date
forbidden: starter, pitcher, lineup, team, venue, weather, umpire
realized PA as a model feature

comparators.empirical_bayes_player_rate_pa_200: fold-trained player-rate posterior with 200-PA league prior
comparators.all_prior_catboost_core_v3_family: fixed all-prior CatBoost core family; no player identity or context features; exact inherited parameters

separate_components.hits: per-PA P(single or double or triple or home_run)
separate_components.hr_over_0_5: per-PA P(home_run); not a full-game market probability

gates.coverage_definition: Only rows in the four predeclared outer validation windows are eligible for OOF scoring. Earlier first-fold training rows are reported separately as initial_training_only_rows; coverage_loss_within_scored_windows must be zero.
gates.proper_score_materiality: candidate-minus-each comparator point and date-block 95% upper bound must each be below negative 1% of comparator Brier and log loss separately for every component
gates.calibration: report diagnostics only; no calibration transform is fitted after fold selection
gates.discrimination: candidate AUC must be noninferior to every comparator in every outer fold and aggregate separately for each component
gates.chronology: every outer train date strictly precedes its validation dates; nested selection sees only its outer training dates
gates.promotion: a 2023 development survivor is not a promotion and cannot reopen 2024 selection or use spent 2025 HR confirmation
